title: Tom and His Pocket Money
text:
Tom is ten years old. Every Saturday, his grandmother gives him five euros of pocket money. Tom likes to save his money in a small blue box. He wants to buy a new football next year.

Last month, Tom saw a red bike in a shop window. The bike cost fifty euros. Tom counted his money and had only twenty-five euros in his box. So he decided to help his neighbour wash her car every Sunday to earn more money.

questions.text: How much pocket money does Tom get every Saturday?
How much does the red bike cost?
Why does Tom decide to help his neighbour?
options: He wants to earn more money for the bike
He does not like his neighbour
He wants to go shopping on Sunday
He has no homework to do

questions.text: What kind of person is Tom, based on the passage?

vocabulary.definition: money that a child receives regularly to spend
to keep money instead of spending it
a person who lives near you

paragraph_translations: Tom tem dez anos. Todo sábado, a avó dele lhe dá cinco euros de mesada. Tom gosta de poupar o dinheiro em uma pequena caixa azul. Ele quer comprar uma bola de futebol nova no próximo ano.

No mês passado, Tom viu uma bicicleta vermelha na vitrine de uma loja. A bicicleta custava cinquenta euros. Tom contou o seu dinheiro e tinha apenas vinte e cinco euros na caixa. Então, decidiu ajudar a vizinha a lavar o carro todo domingo para ganhar mais dinheiro.
